title: D2 automatic cognate clustering against expert judgments
protocol_b_cubed_rule: first expert cognate-set label per form; forms without expert labels excluded; B-cubed calculated within concept
secondary_pairwise_rule: unordered pairs within concept; only confident expert rows retained; pair positive if any confident expert cognate-set label is shared
limitations: The expert coding is a reference standard for this benchmark, not an independent adjudication.
Pairwise observations are dependent because each form occurs in multiple pairs.
No threshold tuning or held-out validation is performed.
Cognate agreement does not measure semantic correctness, borrowing detection, or phylogenetic accuracy.
